feature_contract.goal: Remove R31 WVP validation and R32 stereo safety/DirectGPU/Reset diagnostic counter writes from disabled-telemetry gameplay while retaining identical safety and OpenXR rendering decisions and full sampled statistics.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R31 and R32 diagnostic-only counters; R30 owned draw routing and SkyGlow, R33 physical hooks, all DX11/DXVK/FFB/localization behavior unchanged.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Confirmed from GitHub source at 0a895d3a: R31 increments live-validation and rejection statistics for every 16th eligible draw even when telemetry is disabled, while R32 increments snapshot, batch failure, zero-disparity, direct identity, Reset rearm and reset failure counters outside its five-second opt-in diagnostics. Those cache-line writes are unrelated to the safety decisions; hardware p95 improvement is not assumed.
trace_stages: R31 verified c64..c67 and shader epoch require the live WVP safety cadence across original D3D9 Draw.
R32 right-eye world replay, failed snapshot/interop/Reset and WVP batch must retain fail-closed and state recovery semantics.
R32 opt-in Present five-second diagnostics aggregate R31 validation events and R32 failure metrics without changing host XR eye composition.
subcomponents: Elide R31 live WVP validation and rejection diagnostic writes when VRTelemetry is false without removing validation or generation quarantine.
Elide every R32 snapshot, WVP upload failure, forced mono fallback, DirectGPU identity, Reset success/failure diagnostic write while leaving device/interop/replay state mutation intact.
Add 30 destructive regression mutations and integrate dedicated verifier in exact-SHA Win32 DX9Ex Active gate.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: R31 counters are telemetry-gated while every 16th reliable candidate is validated and rejected generations still block stereo.
R32 counters are telemetry-gated and fallbacks, identity invalidation, Reset and sampled statistics remain functional with negative mutations rejected.
Final source+verifier SHA passes full DX9Ex Active policy and Win32 game/host/package plus Domain Isolation and Source Impact when applicable.

runtime_note: RUNTIME_VALIDATION=UNTESTED: no Quest3/VDXR/gameplay session or FPS p95 measurement; code/build CI success is not HMD correctness or speed proof.

diagnosis.original_evidence: GitHub target branch 0a895d3a at dispatch: R31 WVP live-check/reject counters and six R32 snapshot, WVP upload failure, fail-closed, host identity, Reset rearm/failure statistics were incremented independently of VRTelemetry.
source_trace: Original game D3D9 shader c64..c67 and StateBlock-authoritative live WVP sampling enter R31Draw fast world stereo route.
R31 shader/pose-generation checks plus 16-candidate live validation and R32 SetWvpBatch/LiveEffectSnapshot/DirectGPU/Reset execute fail-closed safety decisions.
R32 five-second opt-in telemetry consumes R31 WVP validation counters and R32 batch/snapshot/DirectGPU/Reset failure counters while x64 OpenXR host continues right-eye composition.
diagnosis.root_cause: Counters served only R32's opt-in reporting, yet their hot-path producers performed unnecessary writes while telemetry was disabled. WVP cadence and fail-closed decisions depend on other state, so diagnostic writes can be gated without changing safety.
alternatives_rejected: Turning off five-second logging alone leaves the counter writes on every eligible draw or fault.
Removing WVP candidate cadence or ignoring rejection would undermine rendering correctness and is explicitly rejected by negative mutations.
Suppressing fallback/Reset/DirectGPU state mutation would break recovery; only the diagnostic ++ operations are gated.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Changed R31/R32 C++ only for 8 diagnostic counter sites. Original validation cadence, generation quarantine, snapshot fallback, shader identity restore, host interop release and Reset invalidation remain. Full game/host/package DX9Ex Active Win32 run #38516866234 5/5 SUCCESS.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: tools/verify_vr_r31_r32_off_counters.py executes 30 destructive mutations for lost/forced counters and safety invariants; exact-SHA DX9Ex Active policy passed. Domain Isolation #38516866810 and Full Source Impact #38516866128 succeeded.
